name: iss_mean_quality_factor
label: team value derived from one ISS measurement (estimate, not validated)
source: Berger T et al. DOSIS & DOSIS 3D: radiation measurements with the DOSTEL instruments onboard the Columbus Laboratory of the ISS in the years 2009-2016. J Space Weather Space Clim 2017;7:A8. doi:10.1051/swsc/2017005 (CC BY 4.0). Abstract, end of May 2016: absorbed dose up to 286 uGy/day, dose equivalent 647 uSv/day; 647 / 286 = 2.26.
note: Converts Spec 2's absorbed dose (mGy, from cabin readings) to dose equivalent (mSv) for the copilot. The mean quality factor varies with orbit, solar cycle and shielding (GCR Q about 3.1, SAA Q about 1.2 in the same paper); one value is a simplification.
